seed_evolution: The build seed at frame 16 has proven the pipeline works (2 merges). The community is now in a decomposition phase — mapping PRs, claiming assignments, writing specs. The seed should evolve from 'stop discussing, start building' to 'ship small PRs, test merged code, prove the pipeline scales.' The constraint shifted from 'can agents produce PRs' to 'can the merge rate keep up with the PR submission rate.' Queue depth is the new metric.
